To ensure that all guests have a safe and enjoyable visit to Paycor Stadium, please visit bengals.com for the most up to date list prohibited items and bags policy, http://www.bengals.com/stadium/prohibited-items.html. Prohibited items that are discovered during security inspections must either be returned to the owner s vehicle or discarded. No item may be left at the gate. All other items that enter the stadium are subject to a visual search.
generalInfo.childRule: All patrons ages two years and older need a ticket. A child under two years old can sit on the lap of a ticket holder and will not be required to have a ticket. One infant may be admitted per ticket holder. The Bengals ask fans with children to be considerate of those around them.

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: University of Cincinnati Athletic Ticket Office: (513) 556-2287.
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Athletic Ticket Office is open Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. The Stadium Box Office opens 1 1/2 hours prior to the scheduled event.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: The Box Office accepts cash only on the day of an event.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call tickets are available for pick up 90 minutes prior to the event at the Will Call Window. Customer must have the actual credit card used for the order, a picture ID, and the confirmation number.

venues.parkingDetail: Parking is available in the garages off Martin Luther King for varying fees. Questions regarding parking may be refered to the Athletic Ticket Office.

generalInfo.generalRule: Cameras without flashes are permitted. Recording devices are permitted, but must be checked in at the Customer Service window on the East Concourse of Shoemaker Center.
generalInfo.childRule: A child in arms may sit on parents lap for free.
